basic_ipo_description_summary: AJC Jewel IPO , a SME IPO of ₹14.59 Cr opens for subscription from June 23, 2025 to June 26, 2025 . The IPO consists of ₹14.59 Cr fresh issue. The face value of each share is 10, and the price band is set between 90.00-95.00 per share . Retail investors can apply to the AJC Jewel SME IPO with a minimum application of 2 lots, each comprising 1200 shares—amounting to a total investment of Rs228000 . The tentative listing date on the exchange (BSE SME) is 01-07-2025 . Stay tuned with us to get more details about AJC Jewel SME IPO including business overview, financial performance, live subscription status, allotment details, daily grey market premium (GMP), listing date, and listing price.
